capabilities: Detect publication citations in Reading View and Live Preview as you type
Convert detected citations into clickable wol.jw.org search links
Accept flexible user-written citation variants (years, page ranges, paragraph marks)
Open links in a chosen language from 25 supported languages
Configure link color via presets or custom hex value
extras: The manifest carries an unreviewed-plugin notice; the README warns that unofficial forks exist and names its own GitHub repo as the official source. Requires manually downloading files into .obsidian/plugins/ rather than a marketplace install.
problem: Obsidian does not recognize or auto-link publication citation abbreviations such as w15 2/15 or it-1 450, so readers must search wol.jw.org manually.

relations.evidence: When the tra.VER:ture plugin is also enabled, publication abbreviations that collide with Bible-book abbreviations

summary: Citation parser that detects Jehovah's Witnesses publication references in notes and turns them into links to wol.jw.org searches.
